messages:
Maya: Heads up — post-launch tradeoff: we have a retry spike (~10% retries on long prompts in NA) and DemoCorp needs a 'history-trim' demo for Tue. Do we do bug-first or ship opt-in feature for the demo?

Ben: Can history-trim be a short client-side flag + server opt-in? If yes, I can ship it fast (few hours).

Aria: The retry spike looks like KV cache eviction on large contexts after last runtime tweak. It's causing tail retries, severity = high.

Maya: If the bug is high we should patch, but if the feature is trivial and behind a flag sales can demo. Need plan.

Priya: Sales notes DemoCorp will demo only if they see the trim flow. They accept opt-in access.

Sanjay: I can implement a cache-window pin to avoid eviction regression, but it needs tests and a canary -> ~48h.

Ben: I'll add a server gate and UI flag: `demo_history_trim=true` in /feature-flags. Estimate 6h dev + test.

Maya: Proposal: parallel two-track: (1) Ben ships opt-in flag for DemoCorp today, (2) Sanjay runs runtime hotfix canary in NA (5% -> 24h monitor). If canary stable, promote and schedule GA next sprint.

Priya: I'll send DemoCorp opt-in instructions and a staging invite once flag is on staging.

DeployBot: Ticket created: INF-3021 runtime-cache-hotfix (assignee: Sanjay). Canary plan drafted.

CI Bot: PR queued -> #4247 (Ben) -> feature-flag: demo_history_trim.

Ben: PR merged to staging, flag enabled in staging. Sending QA invite.

Aria: Running functional + load tests on staging for the trimmed history flow. So far looks clean.

Sanjay: Canary started: patch v1.2.2 -> env: na-prod -> 5% traffic. Monitoring dashboards: dashboards.link/retries and dashboards.link/latency

Maya: Updating roadmap board and adding follow-up GA ticket if canary passes.

Priya: DemoCorp confirmed demo Tue 10am PT. Sales is relieved.

Sanjay: Canary 6h check: error-rate on patched hosts down ~60%. Continuing to monitor tail latency.

Aria: Load profile looks stable under 5% traffic. No regressions in p95.

Maya: OK. If canary stays stable for 24h we'll expand and plan GA in next muted deploy window. Ben keep flag gated to opt-in customers.

Priya: Sending DemoCorp onboarding + staging creds now.

Ben: :party_parrot:

DeployBot: Canary stable 24h -> promoted to 50% -> GA window scheduled.
